annotations.text:
RACK (chosen direction)
Multi-camera first: the rack on the left shows every Tail 2 with tally state and a small live picture, the selected camera is large in the middle, presets are a dense table with MIDI and keyboard columns and no cap on count. Keyboard-centric: 1/2/3 switch cameras, QWEASDZC jog, T track, R record, H home.

SUPPORTING SCREENS
Add camera: name + IP, VISCA port defaults to 52381, video source auto-fills rtsp://IP:8554/live, test result shows firmware and position.
Mapping: every control is an action with MIDI / OSC / keyboard columns and a Learn button; one row shown mid-learn. Camera select is mappable too.
Kept for reference: the two directions that were not chosen. Control Room (single-camera console) and Deck (touch preset wall).
